hotels.vendor_name: Grand Mercure Basildene Manor Accor Vacation Club Apartments
hotels.title: Margaret River Heritage Manor Escape by Grand Mercure Basildene Manor
hotels.description: Set on manicured grounds in Margaret River, this stately manor-style retreat pairs heritage charm with polished interiors, just minutes from the town’s acclaimed galleries, boutiques and gourmet produce stores. Nearby, stroll the leafy main street for artisanal chocolates at Gabriel Chocolate and refined regional dining at Miki’s Open Kitchen. The surrounding Margaret River region is famed for world-class wineries, with cellar doors such as Voyager Estate and Leeuwin Estate within easy reach. Between tastings, venture to Surfers Point, explore Mammoth Cave or follow the coast to Smiths Beach’s sweeping white sand and clear Indian Ocean waters

hotels.vendor_name: Pullman Bunker Bay Resort, Margaret River Region
hotels.title: Margaret River Region Pullman Luxury Villas with Direct Beach Access
hotels.description: Experience five-star luxury in Western Australia's Margaret River region - and find yourself perched alongside the pristine sands of the near-private Bunker Bay, with direct beach access. Set among 35 acres of breathtaking native landscapes, indulge in an evening of culinary delight at the Other Side of the Moon Restaurant and Bar, where local and Indigenous flavours perfectly pair with the region's applauded wines. Float away in the heated infinity-edge swimming pool, try your hand at a game of tennis, relax at the world-class day spa or follow salt-licked walking trails along Cape Naturaliste's majestic coastline.
